subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 2: Story – The great clean-up
outcomes: Understand the main events of the story The great clean-up.
Use comparatives like deeper than and wider than.

tf.s: The Great Clean-up is at Wadi Darbat.
tf.why: Yes! It happens at Wadi Darbat.

tf.s: There's a lot of fruit by the wadi.
tf.why: There's a lot of rubbish by the wadi.

tf.s: The children wear gloves on their hands.
tf.why: Correct! Gloves keep their hands safe.

tf.s: First they pick up the rubbish, then they put their gloves on.
tf.why: They put their gloves on first.

tf.s: The mud is deeper than Fatma's shoes.
tf.why: Well done! The mud is very deep.

tf.s: The children put the rubbish in boxes.
The wood is wider than the bag.
tf.why: Yes! So Bo can't put it in the bag at first.

tf.s: They can put all the rubbish in their shed.
tf.why: They can use only some of it for their shed.

tf.s: You can make a pen holder from a can.
tf.why: Great idea! We can reuse rubbish.

tf.s: Bottles are part of the rubbish by the wadi.
tf.why: Yes! They find bottles, cans, bags and wood.

boxes.q: Which word means things we throw away?
boxes.why: Rubbish is what we throw away.

boxes.q: What do they put in the biggest bags?
boxes.why: Wood and cans go in the biggest bags.

boxes.q: What is deeper than Fatma's shoes?
boxes.why: The mud is deeper than her shoes.

boxes.q: What is the problem at the wadi?
boxes.why: There's a lot of rubbish by the wadi.

boxes.q: Complete: The wood is ___ than the bag!
boxes.why: We compare two things with 'wider than'.

boxes.q: Which is rubbish from the story?
boxes.why: They find cans, bottles and wood.

boxes.q: You can make a lamp from a...
boxes.why: A bottle can become a lamp.

o: pick up rubbish and make a place tidy
boxes.why: A clean-up makes a place clean.

boxes.q: Which do you wear on your feet?
boxes.why: We wear shoes on our feet.

boxes.q: What can you make with the rubbish?
boxes.why: We can reuse rubbish to make a table.

mcq.q: What can we reuse a bottle for?
mcq.why: I can make a plant pot with a bottle.

mcq.q: Complete: A mountain is ___ than a hill.
mcq.why: A mountain is higher than a hill.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: The wadi is more long than the road.
o: The wadi is longer than the road.
The wadi is long than the road.
The wadi is more longer than the road.
The wadi is longest than the road.
My gloves are dirtier than yours!
My gloves are dirtyer than yours!
My gloves are more dirty than yours!
My gloves are dirtier then yours!

mcq.q: Why can't Bo put the wood in the bag at first?
o: Because the wood is wider than the bag.
Because the bag is full of mud.
Because the wood is very small.
mcq.why: The wood is too wide for the bag.

o: Adjectives ending in -y change y to i and add -er.

mcq.q: Why do the children wear gloves?
o: To keep their hands safe and clean from the rubbish.
Because gloves are wider than bags.
mcq.why: Gloves protect your hands when you pick up rubbish.
